manifest.description: Diagnose Rust module trees that no longer represent ownership, crate boundaries, public re-exports, or bin/lib responsibility.
when_to_use: main.rs, providers.rs, or another module carries unrelated library behavior
mod declarations and re-exports encode history rather than ownership
a correction plan may use rust-extract-to-submodule or rust-bin-to-lib-migration
anti_patterns: do not use for module tree generation a tool can produce by itself
do not use for unused imports or dead code
do not hide the G22 caveat when recommending rust-bin-to-lib-migration
